name: slack-agentic-api-app
description: Self-hosted Slack assistant using Agentic API over WebSocket: access control, files, thread memory, and resumable research.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check src/agentic-client.js && node --check src/research.js && node --check list-users.js && node --check check-files.js
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test test/*.test.js && node --import ./test/e2e/setup.mjs test/e2e/help.test.mjs && node --import ./test/e2e/setup.mjs test/e2e/research.test.mjs && node --import ./test/e2e/setup.mjs test/e2e/chat.test.mjs
